name: Church Relationship
overview: Scripture reveals that the church is divinely established by Christ as a steadfast spiritual community, built upon the foundation represented by Peter as the rock (Matthew 16:18). Jesus is the exclusive way to the Father, emphasizing the church's central role in salvation through Him (John 14:6). The church is a living body that grows as the Lord adds those who are saved (Acts 2:47) and is carefully shepherded by overseers appointed by the Holy Spirit, purchased by Christ's own blood (Acts 20:28). Believers are called to dedicate themselves wholly as living sacrifices, serving God in a holy and acceptable manner within this body (Romans 12:1).
